info.description: MVP contract from API.md. Secret, audit-log and admin routes require further database-backed integration testing. State-changing requests require an Origin matching CLIENT_ORIGIN. Login sets an httpOnly cookie; configure Hoppscotch to send cookies.

Platform Admin only. Returns name, status, createdAt and memberCount, never secrets or membership-protected details.
